name_zh: 屠呦呦/中医/青蒿素/诺贝尔/古今中西/诺奖第一人/科技自立
description_zh: 屠呦呦 (1930-) 中国药学家，从葛洪《肘后备急方》中提炼青蒿素挽救全球数亿疟疾生命，2015 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖中国大陆科学家首奖，"古今中西" 研究范式确立中医药现代化路径，青蒿素挽救生命数亿成为中国科技自立最强注脚。
description_en: Tu Youyou (1930-) Chinese pharmacologist, extracted artemisinin from Ge Hong Handbook of Prescriptions saving hundreds of millions malaria lives globally, 2015 Nobel Physiology or Medicine first Chinese mainland scientist, ancient-modern research paradigm established TCM modernization path, artemisinin saving hundreds of millions lives strongest footnote for China tech self-reliance.
reason_zh: 屠呦呦代表中医药如何通过现代科学方法实现传统知识的创造性转化，展示了"古今中西" 研究范式如何打通传统典籍与现代药理学，其诺贝尔奖打破中国大陆科学家零的突破，青蒿素成为中国科技惠及人类最强证明。
reason_en: Tu represents how TCM achieves creative transformation of traditional knowledge through modern scientific methods, demonstrating how ancient-modern paradigm bridges classical texts and modern pharmacology, her Nobel breaking Chinese mainland scientist zero breakthrough, artemisinin becoming strongest proof of China tech benefiting humanity.

expected_en: Master how classical texts transform into life-saving drugs via modern science, grasp ancient-modern methodology bridging tradition and modernity, evaluate Tu artemisinin/Nobel first decisive contribution for TCM modernization and China tech self-reliance.
